name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
summary: At Freewind Post, Cliffwatcher Longhorn watches over the Horde's isolated hold in Thousand Needles. He directs its defense against the Galak centaur and keeps an eye on the Grimtotem tribe's dealings.

sections.title: Guardian of the Mesas
sections.body: Cliffwatcher Longhorn guards Freewind Post, an isolated settlement atop the rock spires of Thousand Needles. He oversees its daily security and gathers reports from scouts on the canyon floor and nearby ridges. Hostile forces are gathering around the post, so his steady leadership guides its defenses.

sections.title: Centaur Hostility and Grimtotem Intrigue
sections.body:
Galak centaur probe Freewind Post's perimeter from the canyon below. Cliffwatcher Longhorn sends adventurers to drive them back and reduce their numbers.

His concern for the Grimtotem tauren runs deeper still. Their secretive camp lies near the post, and Longhorn distrusts them. He arranges reconnaissance to seize their hidden notes, which reveal treachery within the tribe and Arnak Grimtotem's violent crimes.

faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn commands Freewind Post, the Horde outpost in Thousand Needles. He organizes scouts, defense patrols, and responses to nearby threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Cliffwatcher Longhorn?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn stands atop Freewind Post's main mesa in Thousand Needles. Take the lift from the canyon floor, then cross the wooden bridges.

faq.q: Why is Longhorn concerned about the centaur?
faq.answer: Scouts such as Brave Moonhorn report a sharp rise in Galak centaur hostility. Longhorn orders strikes to pacify the clan and keep them from overwhelming the approaches to Freewind Post.

faq.q: What is his interest in the Grimtotem tribe?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem live among the Horde, yet act in secret and with malice. Longhorn suspects foul play, so he commissions adventurers to take their hidden notes and learn what they are plotting.

faq.q: Who is Arnak Grimtotem and why does Longhorn want him?
faq.answer: Arnak Grimtotem carried out a violent attack on Freewind Post's inhabitants. Longhorn places a bounty on him so Arnak faces justice for his treachery.

faq.q: Does Cliffwatcher Longhorn have any family?
faq.answer: Yes. Cliffwatcher Longhorn's brother, Nataka Longhorn, is stationed far to the west at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Duty leaves Cliffwatcher little time to write to him.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Longhorn's Shu'halo frontier spirit. He watches over contested sacred mesas while facing bitter, unresolved friction with the Grimtotem tribe.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on Freewind Post to help secure supply lines across southern Kalimdor. Longhorn works to hold the Horde's precarious foothold amid hostile centaur territory.
